recipes.network_enforcement: Every Lean replay runs inside bubblewrap with an unshared network namespace, a read-only host root, and only a fresh temporary output directory writable.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact seven-line UTF-8 PASS/FAIL-CLOSED summary bound by validation-receipt.json

recipes.scope_boundary: Trust-zero, network-isolated worker replay of the exact statement, conditional compositions, one partial proof transport, and a separately written same-worker no-import reconstruction. It covers zero frozen obligations because the transport has only a planned signature fingerprint and no master-accepted interface mapping. It supplies no local or global Kronecker-Weber package, exact-root proof, release hermeticity, or distinct-runner independence.

legacy_specs_boundary: validation-specs.json remains the obligation-tree phase artifact. Its 25 recipes are closure-credit false and stale at the integrated HEAD because their checker binds the historical obligation-tree base revision.
status_boundary: A passing recipe self-tests only a truthful blocked validation packet. It cannot promote the proof dependency, close a frozen obligation or the root, or establish M0/E0/E1, AUDIT-Z, THEOREM-Z, release, or master acceptance.
